thread:
Kara (Product): quick brainstorm — what if we ship a "modular commit" path: very low base commit + opt-in addons (burst, priority, cached responses). aim: lower entry for mid-market. thoughts?

Evan (Finance): sounds promising. need clear revenue floor and overage deterrent. base commit = how low?

Kara (Product): thinking ~15% of current Starter. addons priced as percentage uplifts. overage = stepped multipliers.

Maya (Sales): customers will ask for hard caps. can we offer hard-cap addon that blocks requests above limit? Procurement likes that.

Ravi (Eng): hard-cap is easiest to implement. pooled burst is harder (allocation + fairness). per-tenant burst + header tag `X-RW-Billing` is quick.

Ben (Legal): require explicit opt-in for pooled burst and clear contract language on conversion from trial to paid. include dispute window (45 days).

Sam (Product Ops): launch checklist ideas: 2 pilots signed, billing simulation pass (1 month), manual reconciliation process automated, legal text approved.

Kara (Product): proposed overage: 1.5x up to 1.5x commit, 2.5x beyond. require 3mo minimum term for modular plans.

Evan (Finance): agree on 3mo min. also model scenario where 30% buy at least one addon.

Maya (Sales): will recruit 3 pilots — two mid-market, one enterprise for hard-cap + SLA.

Ravi (Eng): infra tasks (MVP): add billing tag header, per-tenant burst counter, basic throttle. estimate 3 sprints.

Sam (Product Ops): pilot success metrics: <1% billing drift vs sim, >20% addon attach within 60 days, zero priority-lane SLO violations.

Kara (Product): action items: @Ravi infra estimate, @Evan sims, @Ben contract snippets, @Sam pilot checklist. plan to put card on roadmap after estimates.

plan-bot: action items recorded, due next weekly sync.
